impact: Title, authors, identifier, date, design, and source type must be stored outside LiteratureAtom even though the pipeline requires source metadata.
suggested_extension: Add a PublicationRecord model or atom-bundle envelope keyed by publication_id.

gap: No native multi-arm or multi-metric result grouping
impact: One table row can report agreement, emergent recall, no-verdict count, and p-value; representing these requires multiple atoms or overloading one QuantitativeResult.
suggested_extension: Add result_group_id and metric-specific outcome/result objects.

gap: No explicit comparator estimate separate from the focal estimate
impact: QuantitativeResult.estimate can hold only one scalar, while arms carry values without semantic designation of the contrast.
suggested_extension: Add contrast type, reference arm, absolute/relative effect, and direction.

impact: Agreement, recall, no-verdict rate, and severe under-triage counts use different denominators and interpretation, but the schema relies on free-text effect_measure and unit.
suggested_extension: Add MetricDefinition with numerator, denominator, metric family, and preferred direction.

impact: The paper distinguishes primary prespecified, secondary uncorrected, descriptive, underpowered, confounded, and package-level findings; tags are insufficiently typed.
suggested_extension: Add analysis_role, multiplicity_status, causal_identification_status, and evidential_status enums.

gap: No structured risk-of-bias or appraisal field
impact: Reference coupling, contamination, simulator confounding, missing checkpoints, and clinical non-validity cannot be attached as typed appraisal without misclassifying them as reported limitations.
suggested_extension: Keep appraisal separate in an AppraisalFinding model linked to atom_ids.

impact: Corpus lineage, repair history, provider snapshots, model checkpoints, and evaluation-harness versions are central to this paper but cannot be normalized.
suggested_extension: Add ArtifactProvenance/DataLineage models and references from atoms.

gap: No support for absent or unavailable supplement status
impact: Claims that depend on an unavailable supplement cannot be marked as partially verifiable in the atom itself.
